latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of qclaw-env — an end-to-end environment diagnosis and installation tool for OpenClaw.

- Provides comprehensive, platform-specific environment checks and guided installation workflows.
- Mandates a strict "detect before install" flow for all CLI/tools/runtime/package manager installations.
- Includes full environment snapshots, network connectivity checks (with mirror/config recommendations), and dependency chain diagnosis prior to installation.
- Supports user-friendly, step-by-step instructions for manual steps with clear feedback requirements.
- Differentiates tool/command names across macOS and Windows; does not support Linux installations.
